audience: Busy mobile users who abandon high-effort journaling and do not want personal memory turned into a feed
audience_problem: The moments worth remembering arrive when there is no time or desire to perform them publicly
audience_outcome: Save one ordinary private moment and receive a useful weekly reflection without social pressure
product_truth: The benchmark concept turns one user-saved daily moment into a private weekly reflection card.
brand_voice: Quiet, observant, emotionally exact, non-performative and never wellness-cliche
primary_goal: Qualified private first saves followed by voluntary week-one return
recent_organic_signal_context: Overridden only by a verified recent signal pack at runtime.
signal_provenance: Overridden only by a verified recent signal pack at runtime.
